about: Only what FreeCAD's PartDesign Hole thread tables lack (sizes, majors and tap drills come from FreeCAD): a Unified size's threads per inch, which FreeCAD's Python does not give, and its tap drill's name. Your own sizes FreeCAD has no row for go in ~/.config/workshop_make/threads.json with nominal, pitch and tapDrill (metric) or majorInch, tpi and tapDrillInch (Unified).

#4-40.source: ASME B1.1 threads per inch (FreeCAD's Python gives no Unified pitch); the usual tap drill's name
